name: Talaván (Spain)
description: White field with a blue wavy bend sinister from the lower hoist to the upper fly bearing a yellow boat with a ferryman, a green cross of Alcántara in the lower hoist and a red cross in the upper fly.
history: Together with the proposal to create the arms, the making of a municipal flag was decided; the council approved the arms in the sessions of 29 October 1992 and 29 April, 16 July and 17 November 1993, and the resolution of the Consejo Asesor de Honores y Distinciones of the Junta de Extremadura followed on 17 May 1994.

features.role: wavy band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, the river Tagus
